The '''Geonosian sonic blaster''', also known as '''Geonosian carbine''', was a powerful, hand-held [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] incorporating sonic wave technology developed by the [[Gordarl Weaponsmiths/Legends|Gordarl Weaponsmiths]]. These weapons were used by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], and saw increased use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:Geonoisan_sonic_blaster_1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A side view of a sonic blaster]]

The weapon was a little longer than a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] and consisted of seven parts; a grip, an aiming vane, an emitter cowl, an oscillation chamber, a reduction chamber, a [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] containment charge chamber and a trigger. The sonic blaster was designed to be used only by Geonosians, by making the trigger oddly placed and hard for non-Geonosians to hold, let alone fire.

The weapon's projectile, similar in function to its larger cousin, the [[LR1K sonic cannon/Legends|LR1K sonic cannon]], consisted of a sphere of condensed sonic energy, encapsulated within a containment sphere. Upon rupture of the containment field - which could be caused by any energy or solid based interference with the field - the sphere would explode in a contained omnidirectional blast, and if hit directly onto a living organism like the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], would cause instant death by rupturing the victim's internal organs. Nevertheless, the sphere could cause severe damage to inanimate targets as well, the intense sonic energy many times simply causing a target to explode, or similarly rupture.

==History==
[[File:SonicBlasterHit-LaPR.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The effects of sonic blaster fire]]

Long before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Geonosian weaponsmiths explored sonic wave theory. Eventually, they built basic generators that could convert sonic vibrations into other forms of energy. Geonosian miners soon came up with sonic hammers, whose basic premise was later evolved into [[Sonic blaster/Legends|sonic blaster]] weaponry.

Gordarl Weaponsmiths also created the [[LR1K sonic cannon/Legends|LR1K sonic cannon]], a larger, artillery version of the sonic blaster.

One variant, the [[Kalranoos carbine]], was a hybrid design based on the Geonosian carbine. It was developed by weapons engineer [[Bobor Kalranoos]].<ref name="SWG:KC">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=item|Kalranoos Carbine}}</ref> Another model, dubbed the '''CY-M carbine''', was used by the [[CY-M Prototype]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:ToOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref>
